description: With Payment Number saved, "Should payment proceed? = No", "Send to Business Unit" selected and the confirmation ticked, the VISIBLE Submit stays disabled and no validation message is rendered — the branch cannot be completed by a user. The only ENABLED Submit is hidden (zero width) and, when clicked programmatically, records outcome 1 (proceed) and routes to Pre-Authorise — the opposite decision. Choosing Yes enables the visible Submit normally, which isolates the fault to the No outcome. Bug: test-reports/bugs/2026-07-29-logis-capture-link-no-branch-submit-disabled.md
